- **Shape:** `l1-face.mjs --pr 36280` is clean at a5ea2daa97: open, draft, base main.

- **Each row, checked against `packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts`:**

  - **`relationship/inline-edit-needs-bulk`** (`lintInlineEditBulk`, about line 308) fires only for a FK that `fieldGroupsPlaceRelationship` places, on whichever of the parent or the child resolves `enable.apiMethods` without `'bulk'`. That matches "a child a group places while … omits `'bulk'`".
  - **`relationship/association-inline-edit`** (R6, about line 1234) fires on `isAssociationName(child) && formInlines(...)`. That is "an association … a group places", and its fix text, to remove the parent's group and leave it a tab, matches "(leave it a tab)".
  - The rule ids and severities are unchanged.
- **`field-types.md`:** the `repeater` row now points a typed list at "a `master_detail` child a parent `fieldGroups[].relatedList` names". That is the rule #36250 teaches and `attachInlineSubforms` applies. The other two rows are only re-punctuated to pay the bytes. `inlineEdit: 'grid'` stays in `relationships.md` only as the form-factor ladder, which is correct.

- **Changeset, read sentence by sentence:** the three triggers, the repeater pointer, and "the rule ids and the lint are unchanged" all match the diff and the source.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a5ea2daa97dfbd3df5deb8b2721b496192b77e39`

Scope: skills/objectstack-data/references/lint-rules.md, skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md + none

Inputs read: card #36252 (body, triage 7073845398, claim 7073908822, os-dev-report 7074267786), PR #36280 (body, file list, net diff against `main`: one commit on merge base `c30ce97cd`, 3 files, +16 / -6), and the check-runs on the head. Code outside the diff was read on `main` (`a6756a28`), never reviewed: `packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts` and `packages/spec/src/data/related-list-body-table.ts` (both blob-identical to `main`), and `packages/spec/src/data/authoring-key-lint.ts`. `main` is 9 commits past the merge base; none of them touches the two hits files, the lint source or the spec helpers.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set: unchanged. The diff edits no schema, no lint, no validator; no key is added, removed, narrowed or widened. Right.
- Public surface: the published `@objectstack/skills` text changes in four table cells (three "Catches" cells in `lint-rules.md`, the `repeater` row in `field-types.md`) plus three punctuation trims in the same `field-types.md` section. Rule ids, severities and row order are unchanged. Right.
- Token ratchet: no ceiling row is moved in the diff (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` is not in the file list); the gate's verdict is the check-run `Lint · repo & tooling gates`: success.
- Evals: no `skills/*/evals` file is in the diff, and none on `main` names the three rule ids, so nothing pins the old wording. Right.
- Check-runs on the head: every run completed; conclusions are success or skipped (opt-in, UI-only and matrix-template rows), none failed or pending. `Check Changeset`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Test Core`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Lint & Repo Gates`: success.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/36252-lint-rules-field-group.md` declares `@objectstack/skills` patch. The diff publishes corrected prose only, so patch is the right level. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body and in the changeset agrees with the diff: nothing an author could write before is refused now, and nothing new is accepted. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right: no protocol surface is touched. `Check Changeset`: success.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty. Nothing to answer.
- Seat-added scope (`field-types.md`, the `repeater` row): accepted. It is the same stale `inlineEdit` claim in the same skill, and it is recorded on the claim thread and in the PR body.
- Declared precision limit (the `line-items-inline-edit` cell does not spell the group-placeable precondition): accepted, see N1 in ④.
- `lint-rules.md` spends its one byte of headroom (934 tokens before and after, ceiling 934): accepted; the ratchet gate is green and no ceiling moves.
- Process deviations in the dev report (push probe refused once, assignee carried per `os-dev.md`, trailer and footer per AGENTS.md, a whole-workspace build to satisfy four dist-reading gates, `test:repo` left to CI): none changes the tree under review; no contract effect. They are the seat's to accept.
- Out-of-scope findings (2): both hold on `main` as read. (a) The `fix` string of `field/embedded-sub-fields` in `packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts` (line 1118) still says `inlineEdit: 'grid'` edits the typed list inline. (b) `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` on `main` still teaches `inlineEdit: true` as what inlines a child in the parent form (lines 251 to 314). Neither is in this diff; each needs its family card or its open PR named by the seat. Not escalated as a blocker here.
- SQL push-down: not applicable. The diff contains no code, no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

`skills/objectstack-data/references/lint-rules.md`, each changed cell against the lint on `main`:

- `relationship/line-items-inline-edit`, "a `*_line`/`*_item` master_detail child placed by no parent field group (`fieldGroups[].relatedList`)". Holds. R5 fires inside the `master_detail` branch when `isLineItemName(obj.name)`, `isGroupPlaceableRelationship(def)` and not `formInlines(...)`; `formInlines` is `fieldGroupsPlaceRelationship` over the parent's `fieldGroups`, which reads each group's `relatedList`. Severity `suggestion` matches the row. The rule reads `inlineEdit` nowhere.
- `relationship/inline-edit-needs-bulk`, "a child a group places while the parent's or child's `enable.apiMethods` omits `'bulk'`". Holds. `lintInlineEditBulk` skips every relationship that is not group-placeable or not placed by a parent field group, then warns once per object, parent or child, whose declared `enable.apiMethods` disallows `bulk`. Severity `warning` matches.
- `relationship/association-inline-edit`, "an association (comment/audit/activity) a group places (leave it a tab)". Holds. R6 fires when `isAssociationName(obj.name)` and `formInlines(...)` is true; its message says to leave it a tab of the record page, and its `fix` removes the group. Severity `warning` matches.

Break attempts: an author who sets `inlineEdit` on a line-item FK and adds no group still gets the R5 suggestion, which the new cell predicts and the old one did not. An author who places an association with a group gets R6 whatever `inlineEdit` says, also as the new cell predicts. A child placed by a group with `bulk` withheld on the parent alone is warned on the parent, as the cell says. No case found where following the new text mispredicts the lint, apart from N1.

`skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md`:

- `repeater` row, "a typed list is a `master_detail` child a parent `fieldGroups[].relatedList` names". Holds against the spec's own route sentence (`EMBEDDED_JSON_TYPED_LIST` in `packages/spec/src/data/authoring-key-lint.ts`): a child object whose `master_detail` field points back, and a field group on the parent whose `relatedList` names that child edits its rows as an inline grid. A design built from the row is lint-clean under R5 and is the shape `isBodyTableRelationship` draws in the form.
- The three punctuation trims (section intro, `composite` row, `repeater` row) remove no teaching: "untyped", "no sub-fields", "`fields`/`subFields` are refused" and "no sub-fields or `columns`" all survive.

Nits (no effect on correctness or the contract):

- N1 (nit): the `line-items-inline-edit` cell omits the precondition that the FK is one a group may place; a line-item FK declaring `relatedList: true` or `false` is never flagged. Declared by the dev, at the table's summary level, with zero byte headroom. Accepted deviation.
- N2 (nit): the two lower cells say "a group" where the first says "parent field group". The row directly above defines it and the table is read as a block. Accepted deviation.
- N3 (nit): `rules/relationships.md` calls a group naming a `master_detail` child "written only when asked", while the `repeater` row now points a typed list at exactly that group. An author asking for a typed list has asked for inline rows, so the two do not contradict; the sharper wording belongs to the `relationships.md` family card, not this diff.
